Cost: 50eb (Costly) for 10

Ammo Types Available: Arrows, Bullets, Slugs, and Shells

Sometimes, the easiest method for extra lethality is to just put more power in your shots, though not all iron is suited for such strength.

This ammunition cannot be fired by a Poor Quality weapon without Destroying it (but not beyond Repair). When making an Attack Check with this ammunition and rolling a Critical Success (10), thus rolling an explosion d10, the Attack's damage (before interacting with armor) is increased by the value rolled by the explosion d10 (which is still added to the Attack Check as normal).

Stack: 10

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Ammunition).
